title: Suppression line
description: One JSON-per-line record in suppression/list.jsonl, appended by lib/suppression.py::add(). email and domain are mutually exclusive by design: a whole-domain suppression sets domain and leaves email empty; a single-address suppression sets email and leaves domain null. reason is restricted to VALID_REASONS in that module -- kept in sync by hand, since a JSON Schema enum can't import a Python set. Note: add()'s current signature doesn't take company_name, though every existing record has one -- likely added by an earlier version or a manual entry path; kept required to match the real data.

email.description: empty string for a whole-domain suppression
